summary: Release risk is acceptable at 5f0bc6c3. The prior round's blocker (a spec doc claiming coverage from a deleted .spec.ts) is genuinely fixed, and the doc sweep was independently reproduced in both basename and shorthand .spec.ts forms: zero live references to any of the 17 deleted files remain outside frozen audit artifacts and the roi-ledger. Rollback is a stateless single-commit revert with no migration, persisted schema, or artifact-format change. The seven-slug cross-story containment claim was verified against .vibepro/config.json, not trusted. Two contributor-facing CI changes are build-failing but disclosed, self-describing on failure, and currently green. Two low findings remain, both failing in the safe direction.
